title: Quentin and the Spire
author: Gideon Thackeray
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
